summary: Apollo Asset Backed Credit Company LLC filed an 8-K reporting amendments to its operating agreement and unregistered sales of equity securities. The filing details the issuance of multiple share classes (e.g., A-I, F-I, T-I, I, S, BD) to third-party investors for aggregate cash consideration of approximately $56.3 million, completed on April 24, 2026. These sales were exempt under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D, and/or Regulation S. The amendments added I (Acc) and F-I (Acc) share classes. This represents routine capital-raising activities, not a special situation. There is no control transaction, tender offer, activist campaign, or restructuring.
